big: Nifty Microcap 250 is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Microcap 250 track?
NSE Indices has developed the Nifty Microcap 250 Index which aims to track the performance of microcap stocks listed or permitted to trade on NSE. It holds 254 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
